name: Dome
summary: A parabolic ray from the hand places a translucent selection sphere where it lands, so the user can arc over people in a crowd and select one or several agents behind them.
howItWorks: Built for Meta Quest 3 controllers. A parabolic ray, like the arcs used for teleporting, extends from the right controller and spawns a translucent selection sphere where it hits the ground, a wall or an agent. Pushing the right thumbstick up or down grows or shrinks the sphere, from a single agent to a whole group. Holding the trigger selects every agent inside the sphere and opens a slider for adjusting their volume. Because the arc goes over occluders, agents hidden behind others can be reached. In a study with 24 participants (volume adjustment in a crowd of 28 avatars, in a row and in occluding groups), Dome was as fast as a resizable Flashlight cone but caused more unnecessary adjustments, overshoots and undershoots, and 20 of 24 participants preferred Flashlight; some found Dome useful for clustered groups when no occlusion-handling aid was available.
advantages: Arcs over occluding avatars to reach targets behind them.
An adjustable sphere selects one target or a whole group.
limitations: Harder to aim and size than a straight cone; more unintended selections in the study.
Most participants preferred the Flashlight cone.

relationships.note: Compared with a resizable Flashlight cone that selects all agents inside it.
